requisito: Given a list of (inizio, fine) intervals in minutes, ignores None entries, entries whose length is not 2, negative values, or cases with inizio > fine, sorts the remaining ones, and merges intervals that overlap or touch (inizio <= fine_precedente). Returns [] if the list is None, empty, or has no valid intervals.

difetti.indizio: Look at the condition that decides whether the current interval should merge with the previous one.
difetti.spiegazione: Using inizio < fine_c instead of <= excludes adjacent intervals that touch at an endpoint (such as (10, 20) and (20, 30)), leaving them separate.

difetti.indizio: Look at how the end bound of the merged interval is computed.
difetti.spiegazione: Assigning fine directly instead of max(fine_c, fine) shrinks the interval whenever the second one is fully contained in the first (e.g., (10, 40) and (15, 25) become (10, 25)).
